caseName: Lead Industries Ass'n v. Environmental Protection Agency

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari denied. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these petitions. Reported below: 208 U. S. App. D. C. 1 and 55, 647 F. 2d 1130 and 1184.
